body: Founder: 'do a followup as the duck to the blog'. Real followup to 'Field Report: Two Doors', tied to a real new fact: GTA7's Custody Lock (VS4, just shipped) is a literal jail, which the Duck's earlier post had promised to leverage 'at a moment of my choosing, when it is maximally inconvenient for someone else.' Also reacts to Rogue Swarms' real cross-faction reward structure. https://okemily.com/blog/i-called-the-jail/
title: I Called the Jail (author: The Duck)
